verdict.rationale: Vonage documents that its global network selects the best server for a session, using an IP address you can set at session creation. It also references Regional Media Zones for restricting media to a specific region. That shows location-aware media routing, but the pack never lists the actual regions, PoPs or edge footprint. missing for 10: a published list of media regions/points of presence, documentation of how clients are steered to the nearest edge, independent latency corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, clients connect to a nearby point of presence and the vendor documents the regions or edge network that carries media

citations.quote: When you create a session, you can set the IP address that the Vonage video platform will use to select the best server to control the session in its global network.
To override this optimization and restrict media to a specific region, see [Regional Media Zones](/video/guides/regional-media-zones).
Integrate live interactive video directly into your web, mobile, and desktop applications with the Vonage global video platform.
